reshape_pad_tensor_by_group_size: reshape and pad a PyTorch tensor so its last dimension is divisible by a given group size for quantization
revert_tensor_by_pad: revert a padded and reshaped tensor back to its original shape by removing the padding
get_quant_func: retrieve the appropriate quantization function from the registry based on dtype, bit width, and symmetry flags
float8_e4m3fn_ste: apply a straight-through estimator for float8 e4m3fn quantization to preserve gradient flow during training
update_fused_layer_global_scales: update global scales for fused attention or MLP layers under NVFP4 quantization so q/k/v or gate/up share a scale
